### ApprovalEvidence

```ts
type ApprovalEvidence = typeof ApprovalEvidenceSchema.Type;
```

Metadata only: never raw image bytes, prose, URLs or executable content.

```ts
type ApprovalRecord = typeof ApprovalRecordSchema.Type;
```

### ApprovalView

```ts
type ApprovalView = typeof ApprovalViewSchema.Type;
```

Current holder's projection. A disabled button is not an authorization check.

### ApprovalListInput

Bounded listing request.

### ApprovalAnswerInput

```ts
type ApprovalAnswerInput = typeof ApprovalAnswerInputSchema.Type;
```

Revision-pinned answer. No actor identity is accepted on the wire.

### Approvals

```ts
type Approvals = Readonly<{
  list: Promise<
    Readonly<{
      items: readonly ApprovalView[];
      nextCursor: string | null;
    }>
  >;
  get: Promise<{
    record: {
      recordId: string;
      requester: {
        principalId: string;
        agentId: string | null;
        sessionId: string | null;
        displayName: string;
      };
      module: string;
      operation: string;
      access: "write" | "external";
      description: {
        title: string;
        inputBytes: number;
        inputSha256: string;
      };
      evidence?: readonly object[];
      authorityFence: string;
      reversibility: "reversible" | "irreversible-external";
      state:
        | "pending"
        | "expired"
        | "denied"
        | "requested"
        | "approved"
        | "claimed"
        | "applied"
        | "outcome_unknown";
      by:
        | {
            kind: "human";
            memberId: string;
          }
        | {
            kind: "policy";
          }
        | null;
      reason:
        | "pending"
        | "expired"
        | "not-found"
        | "not-eligible"
        | "already-answered"
        | "stale-revision"
        | "declined"
        | "fenced"
        | "not-granted"
        | "read-only"
        | "in-flight"
        | "outcome-unknown"
        | "identity-conflict"
        | null;
      requestedAt: number;
      expiresAt: number;
      updatedAt: number;
      revision: number;
    };
    canAnswer: boolean;
    canSetAutoApprove: boolean;
  } | null>;
  answer: Promise<
    | Readonly<{
        kind: "refused";
        reason: typeof ApprovalRefusalReasonSchema.Type;
      }>
    | Readonly<{
        kind: "answered";
        view: ApprovalView;
      }>
  >;
  setAutoApprove: Promise<
    | Readonly<{
        kind: "refused";
        reason: typeof ApprovalRefusalReasonSchema.Type;
      }>
    | Readonly<{
        kind: "updated";
        rule: AutoApproveInput;
      }>
  >;
}>;
```

The member-bound capability. Host authentication supplies the actor.

### ApprovalHome

```ts
type ApprovalHome = Readonly<{
  kind: "team" | "oyster" | "local";
  id: string;
}>;
```

Native owner of this ledger; the Local runtime supplies its own SQLite owner.

---

### ApprovalRequest

```ts
type ApprovalRequest = Readonly<{
  requester: ApprovalRecord["requester"];
  module: string;
  operation: string;
  access: ApprovalRecord["access"];
  reversibility: ApprovalRecord["reversibility"];
  authorityFence: string;
  idempotencyKey: string;
  inputJson: string;
}>;
```

A request is host-attested metadata and JSON bytes, never renderer-provided
identity.

---

### AutoApproveQuery

```ts
type AutoApproveQuery = Readonly<{
  agentId: ApprovalRequest["requester"]["agentId"];
  module: ApprovalRequest["module"];
  access: ApprovalRequest["access"];
}>;
```

Host-only policy read for an admitted Agent/module/access selection, not
execution authority.

---

### ApprovalAnswerer

```ts
type ApprovalAnswerer =
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "human";
      memberId: string;
      role: "owner" | "admin" | "member";
      actingForAgent: boolean;
      mayUseOperation: boolean;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "agent" | "key";
    }>;
```

Host-attested human identity and current authority over this exact operation.

---

### ApprovalRuleSetter

```ts
type ApprovalRuleSetter =
  | ApprovalAnswerer
  | (Extract<
      ApprovalAnswerer,
      {
        kind: "human";
      }
    > &
      Readonly<{
        mayManageAgent: boolean;
      }>);
```

Host-attested authority to write one auto-approve rule. A Team home resolves it
against the exact rule: mayUseOperation for that family and mayManageAgent
(agent.manage on that Agent; owners and admins hold it Team-wide). An answerer
without mayManageAgent never manages an Agent. Oyster and Local homes are
owner-only.

---

### ApprovalAdmission

```ts
type ApprovalAdmission =
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "authorized";
      authorityFence: string;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "refused";
      reason: "not-granted" | "read-only";
    }>;
```

Mycelium owns admission; the ledger compares its opaque fence, never grant
grammar.

---

### ApprovalDispatchCompletion

```ts
type ApprovalDispatchCompletion =
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "completed";
      output: typeof Schema.Json.Type;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "refused";
      reason: "not-granted" | "read-only";
    }>;
```

Host verdict outside App JSON: only an attested zero-effect refusal is denied.

---

### ApprovalApplyHost

```ts
type ApprovalApplyHost = Readonly<{
  recheck: (record) => Promise<ApprovalAdmission>;
  dispatch: (request) => Promise<ApprovalDispatchCompletion>;
}>;
```

Host-only adapter to the existing operation door; not an Agent continuation.

---

### ApprovalSubmitHost

```ts
type ApprovalSubmitHost = ApprovalApplyHost &
  Readonly<{
    evidence?: ApprovalEvidence;
  }>;
```

Only the submitting capability may attach evidence; never spread tool input
here.

---

### ApprovalApplyResult

```ts
type ApprovalApplyResult =
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "applied";
      record: ApprovalRecord;
      output: typeof Schema.Json.Type;
    }>
  | ApprovalRefusal;
```

Private result for inline tool output or ordinary deferred new-message delivery.

---

### ApprovalResultNotice

```ts
type ApprovalResultNotice = Readonly<{
  deliveryId: string;
  record: ApprovalRecord;
  result: ApprovalApplyResult;
}>;
```

Deferred result cargo; stored request input is not a field on this port.

---

### ApprovalHandoffResult

```ts
type ApprovalHandoffResult =
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "delivered";
      commandId: string;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "not-required";
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "undeliverable";
    }>
  | ApprovalRefusal;
```

Ordinary new-message receipt, explicit no-delivery result, or typed refusal.
